def encode_message(message):
    # This is a simple encoding method for demonstration purposes.
    return message.encode('utf-8')

def test_hello_passes_routing_metadata(fake_socket_pair):
    address = ("127.0.0.1", 7687)
    sockets = fake_socket_pair(address)
    # Using the helper method for encoding messages
    encoded_message = encode_message("\x00\x03\xB1\x70\xA0\x00\x00")
    sockets.server.sendall(encoded_message)
    connection = Bolt4x2(address, sockets.client, PoolConfig.max_connection_lifetime,
                         routing_context={"foo": "bar"})
    connection.hello()
    tag, fields = sockets.server.pop_message()
    assert tag == 0x01
    assert len(fields) == 1
    assert fields[0]["routing"] == {"foo": "bar"}
